option.counterfactual: There is a known finite AW*-factor containing a bounded increasing sequence with no least upper bound and with a fixed positive quasitrace on every successive difference.
option.approach: Starting from one example, investigate scaling and corner constructions to determine which other positive increment values can be obtained. This could identify the entire set rather than merely establish nonemptiness.

options.counterfactual: The existence of any one example implies the existence of an example with increment exactly one half, even though ordinary scaling and matrix amplification cannot increase the increment.
options.approach: Search for a nonlinear corner construction that increases the increment whenever it is below one half. Seek an explicit improvement formula that can be iterated.

options.approach: Investigate whether the quasitrace is order-continuous for decreasing positive sequences with infimum zero. If a supremum existed, apply that property to its differences from the sequence.
